commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1266/local; gh pr diff 1266 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1266/local/diff.patch | wc -l

echo "=== PR head: remaining 'bash lib/test/run-module' in the three extensions + docs overview ==="; for f in .prflow/prompt-extensions/implement.md .prflow/prompt-extensions/review-and-fix.md .prflow/prompt-extensions/receiving-code-review.md docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md; do echo "--- $f ---"; git show "0db1f5d5:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -n 'bash lib/test/run-module\|run-module.sh' || echo "(none)"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
